content:
maria: Heads-up — trying to cut a hotfix for summarizer mem leak (runtime patch only). Target bump runtime 1.12.3 -> 1.12.4. Canary failing eval gate due to 2 flaky prompts in prompt set A. Requesting a one-time eval-gate exception to push urgent fix. Jira: https://jira/redwood/RED-1234

kevin: Quick q — is this a model vs infra regression?

maria: Not model. No weight change. It's mem fragmentation in the runtime when context >2k. Patch changes allocator and startup kv-clear.

paul-qa: QA: no semantic regressions on random samples. Eval runner flagged throughput delta (-5%) and 2 flaky prompts (A3, A8). We can accept if rollout pinned & rollback guardrails in place.

sophie: oncall/product — need rollback plan + release notes before any exception. Who owns monitoring?

deploybot: deploybot: preflight check failed: eval-gate=FAILED (latency +8ms, tokens/sec -4%). Rollout blocked.

maria: Requesting temporary disable of the eval-gate for this release only. Conditions: 1) pin model to v3.4.2 (no weight change), 2) canary at 10% for 30m, 3) auto-rollback if error-rate > 0.5% OR latency +20ms, 4) post-deploy run of filtered prompt set B (owner: paul-qa). I will own dashboards and alert triage.

kevin: Infra approves conditionally if deploy uses `--mem-tune=low` and startup runs `kv-cache --clear`. I'll review deploy config and watch migrations.

paul-qa: Add note to release notes: "runtime patch - no model change; monitored prompts: B1-B10". QA sign-off pending post-deploy run.

sophie: Product ok with 10% canary. Approve if no semantic drift after 30m. Please create release ticket and tag @product-lead.

deploybot: deploybot: Received exception request. Auto-policy: requires 2 approvals (infra + product). Current approvals: kevin, sophie. Proceeding with canary at 10% in us-east-1. Starting rollout...

```
/deploy canary --image runtime:1.12.4 --pin-model v3.4.2 --weight 10% --args "--mem-tune=low"
```

deploybot: deploybot: Canary pass after 25m. Metrics: error-rate=0.07%, latency +6ms, tokens/sec -2%. Prompts B1-B10 within thresholds. Promoting to 50%.

maria: Thanks all. I'll run the full post-deploy eval set now and update release notes + CHANGELOG. Keeping model pinned to v3.4.2; runtime bumped to 1.12.4.

kevin: I'll add a temporary alert and schedule a follow-up window to re-evaluate `--mem-tune` once fragmentation telemetry is stable.

paul-qa: QA complete. Sign-off given. Release notes: https://confluence/redwood/releases/v3.4.3 (note: runtime-only hotfix).

sophie: Closing exception. Please add a short doc to the eval-gate cookbook describing "runtime-only exceptions" and notify CS for customers on high-context workloads.
